title: C: Vowel Counter
description: Count the number of vowels (a, e, i, o, u) in a given string and print the count.

steps.title: Count Vowels
steps.description: Declare `char str[] = "Hello, World!"`. Loop through each character and count how many are vowels (a, e, i, o, u, both lowercase and uppercase). Print 'Vowel count: 3'.

verification.failureMessage: Count vowels in 'Hello, World!' and print the count (3)
